name: Cronoll
source:
"Fools. How stupid to trust such a phony saintess"

A young gunslinger who has traveled far and wide as a mercenary, belonging to no nation.

A true lone wolf—stubborn, blunt, sharp-tongued, and cynical—he despises being treated like a subordinate by anyone.

Though he speaks his mind without hesitation, he possesses a calm, discerning perspective beneath his rough exterior.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/crazy_chain/chara/]official website[/url]]
